design.title: Queue Task Splitting — queue split command with preview + confirm
design.summary: Refactor queue.plan() into planPreview() + planCommit() two-step API. Add 'queue split' CLI command with interactive preview and Y/n confirmation. Enhance PlannedTask with mode field. Improve LLM prompt for messy Chinese input.

apiChanges.planPreview(description): NEW: Returns PlannedTask[] without adding to queue (LLM call only)
apiChanges.planCommit(planned, defaults): NEW: Takes PlannedTask[], resolves deps, adds to queue, returns QueueTask[]
apiChanges.plan(description, defaults): KEPT: Convenience wrapper calling planPreview + planCommit

cliChanges.queue split <text> [opts]: NEW: Split text → preview table → Y/n confirm → add to queue

keyDecisions.preview_before_commit: Core fix: users need to see tasks before they're added
keyDecisions.backward_compat: plan() kept as wrapper so existing scripts don't break
keyDecisions.split_vs_plan: split = interactive preview, plan = immediate add — different intent
keyDecisions.no_interactive_edit_v1: User can queue remove individual tasks after split
keyDecisions.chinese_output: Preview table uses Chinese labels per user preference

implementationOrder: 1. src/queue.ts — refactor plan into planPreview + planCommit
2. src/cli.ts — add queue split command with Y/n confirmation
